chunks: And Samaʿah narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when the last ten entered, would tighten the waist-wrapper, avoid women, stay awake through the night, and devote himself fully to worship.”

key_terms.أَحْيَا اللَّيْلَ: revived the night, meaning he spent the night in worship
key_terms.اجْتَنَبَ النِّسَاءَ: avoided women, meaning he refrained from marital relations during this period
key_terms.الْعَشْرُ الْأَوَاخِرُ: the last ten nights, referring to the final ten nights of Ramadan
key_terms.الْعِبَادَةِ: worship and devotional acts directed to Allah
key_terms.شَدَّ الْمِئْزَرَ: tightened his waist-wrapper, an expression of earnest resolve and abstinence

ai.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم worship during the last ten nights of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in the last ten nights, showing heightened devotion, restraint, and full dedication to worship. It highlights the spiritual importance of these nights, especially in the month of Ramadan, and presents his conduct as a model of sunnah (prophetic tradition).
